captions.detailed: A large digital countertop air fryer with a matte black outer chassis and a brushed-metal front control panel. On the left, a deep pullout drawer with an integrated handle slides out, revealing a hollow metallic inner basket. The right side features a control stack consisting of a display screen, a rotating selector dial, and two rocker buttons. The drawer slides prismatically, the dial rotates continuously, and the buttons pivot independently.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for an articulated digital air fryer. The model should include a main hollowed black chassis, a brushed metal front panel, a sliding drawer/basket assembly with a handle, and a right-side control interface consisting of a rotating selector dial and two pivotable rocker buttons.
captions.factory: The script defines an ArticulatedObject and constructs its components using CadQuery primitives. The main body is created from a rounded box that is hollowed out to form the heating cavity. The front control panel is a thin plate with cutouts for the display, dial, and buttons. The sliding drawer is built as a hollowed box with a front cover and an attached handle. The dial is modeled as a cylinder with ridges, and the rocker buttons are small rectangular blocks. Prismatic joints are defined for the drawer slide, a continuous joint for the dial, and revolute joints for the rocker buttons.
